method: Read-only comparison of source alpha masks >16, same native dimensions and coordinates, no fitting or warping.
units: Count of pixels whose foreground/background classification differs from neutral.

front.decision: Select v2 as improved draft. Foot silhouette drift reduced; it is not zero. Coral changes and eye motion still require visual approval.

back.decision: Do not select v2: foot drift remains, coral discrepancy worsens, small claw gains an odd projecting finger. Previous back remains draft only.

limitations: Alpha disagreement does not assess internal textures, joints, correct anatomy, colours or motion quality.
These region counts are diagnostic comparisons, not pass scores.
No idle animation is approved for runtime binding.
